title: Pitch The Future
description:
Pitch the Future is Groundswell Startups’ high-tech pitch competition and the capstone of the Space Coast Initiative.

The event brings together early-stage startups from across the Space Coast and Florida to present innovative solutions in AI, hardware, space, defense, and other emerging technologies. Selected finalists will pitch live in front of investors, corporate partners, and ecosystem leaders, with a focus on companies transitioning from prototype to investment readiness. This is a curated, decision-focused event designed to connect founders with capital, strategic partnerships, and long-term support within the Space Coast innovation ecosystem.

Learn more and apply here: [www.spacecoastinitiative.com/pitch](http://www.spacecoastinitiative.com/pitch)
